title: What is an effective way to improve the answer writing skills for the UPSC GS Mains in 3 months?

matched_note.title: UPSC CSE Mains Answer Writing Framework: Structure, Committee Quotes & Data Points

drafted_comment:
The real issue is trying to write 'perfect' answers without a consistent structure. In 3 months, you don't have time to reinvent the wheel; you need a repeatable framework.

Here is how to fix it:

1. Use the 4-Anchor Formula: Every answer must have a Constitutional basis (Article/Statute), Macro Data, a specific Committee Quote (like 2nd ARC or NITI Aayog), and a clear Way Forward. This moves you from 'general' to 'expert' writing.
2. Stop Information Hoarding: Don't try to memorize everything. Focus on mapping current affairs to GS syllabus keywords. Extract only three things from every news item: a fact, a law, and a committee recommendation.
3. Practice with Feedback: Write 2 answers daily using these anchors rather than 10 random ones without a structure.\n
